purpose: Post-upgrade Paperclip native runtime verification artifact. Compares current live runtime state against the T01 baseline (M014-S04-paperclip-baseline.json) to confirm the upstream upgrade succeeded without losing BOS runtime patches, security lockdown, data, or rollback capability. Verdict this turn: BLOCKED_NO_DEPLOY_ARTIFACTS — T02 upgrade contract and T03 deploy/rollback artifacts are absent from runtime-evidence/, so no upgrade actually occurred in this slice and the post-upgrade comparison cannot be anchored to any deployed revision.
verdict_classification_rationale: T04 verdict is the deterministic function f(t02_contract_present, t03_deploy_present, fresh_readback_performed) → BLOCKED_NO_DEPLOY_ARTIFACTS. With t02_contract_present=false and t03_deploy_present=false (filesystem check), no upgrade target SHA is recorded and no deploy actually occurred in this slice. Promoting the verdict to PASS would constitute evidence laundering: a 'verified upgrade' claim without any captured deploy is overconfident. Promoting to BLOCKED_NO_FRESH_READBACK alone would understate the structural gap because even if a fresh readback were available, there would be nothing to compare it against. The accurate description of state at T04 is 'no upgrade was deployed; verification is structurally inapplicable'. Per LFP-LF-01, LFP-S02-01, and the S03 lockfile no-promotion rule, this is the only admissible verdict at T04 with current artifacts.
